Sandbox_DogTiredItemArrange_Arranger_too: On: piles keep growing in layers and long items cross-stack. Off: Item Arrange arranges as it normally does (the extra items this mod adds are still arranged).
Sandbox_DogTiredItemArrange_Layers_toolt: When a floor tile or surface is covered with full stacks, start a new layer on top of them. Only items that make a flat, steady pile do this (boxes, planks, logs, bags, kits, books, sheets...); bottles and other loose items do not.
Sandbox_DogTiredItemArrange_CrossStack_t: Long items such as planks, logs, pipes and bars turn a quarter turn on every other layer, like a lumber pile.
Sandbox_DogTiredItemArrange_MaxPileHeigh: Floor pile height (% of a storey)
How high an arranged pile on the floor may get, as a percentage of the height of one storey. 90 stops just under the ceiling. Shelves, tables and other furniture keep their own limits.
